channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: You’ll want to sit down for this: Changes are coming to Broadway Centre Cinemas
item.description: Changes are coming to Broadway Centre Cinemas. The old blue chairs are being removed and will be replaced with such features as 'loveseat seating' and side tables for snacks

item.title: ‘The world is going to fall in love with dual moguls.’ The Olympics’ newest event is ‘chaotic, exciting, wild.’
item.description: Fast-paced, head-to-head and often unpredictable, dual moguls is a favorite event of skiers — maybe moreso than the the singles races — and it's finally in the Olympics.

item.title: Letter: With a trip outside of America in sight, we’re polishing up on our apologies
item.description: Letter: “Nadamo se da ce biti opozvan i izbacen se duznosti.” That is Croatian for, “Impeach him and kick him out of office.”

item.title: Letter: Does Gov. Cox still think only Trump can unite the country?
item.description: Letter: Remember in 2024 when our governor wrote that gushing love letter to Donald Trump? Do you think Spencer Cox is embarrassed, or do you think he knew exactly what Trump would do as president and didn’t care?

item.title: Letter: Who would approve of the tear-gassing of children? For Utah’s leaders, the answer is not self-evident.
item.description: Letter: What does it say about Utah Republicans that they can’t emphatically agree children should not be tear-gassed? That they can’t say anything without first getting permission from Donald Trump?

item.title: Opinion: Human intelligence — the thing we as educators are duty bound to defend and advance — is under attack
item.description: Opinion: A.I. companies are eating higher education

item.title: Cox quickly signs Utah ‘constitutional court’ into law — but the Legislature isn’t done targeting the judiciary
item.description: Gov. Cox quickly signed a bill creating a ‘constitutional court’ in Utah. It's the latest effort in the Utah Legislature's crusade to reshape the judiciary.

item.title: Patti Edwards, wife of BYU football coach LaVell Edwards, dies at 93
item.description: Patti Edwards, wife of the late BYU football coach LaVell Edwards, passed away at the age of 93, the BYU athletics department announced Saturday.

item.title: Mike Lee’s Trump-backed SAVE America Act could disenfranchise eligible voters
item.description: Months ahead of the 2026 midterm election, Republicans in Congress are pushing legislation that would force states to quickly adopt a flurry of new voting restrictions.

item.title: Damian Lillard wins NBA’s 3-point contest while still rehabbing torn Achilles
item.description: Damian Lillard, still rehabbing a torn Achilles tendon, edges Devin Booker to win the NBA 3-Point Contest for the third time.
